const event=(type,run,stage,message,payload,account='',token='')=>({json:{event_type:type,run_id:run,execution_id:String($execution.id),account_id:account,version_token:token,recorded_at:new Date().toISOString(),stage,message,payload_json:JSON.stringify(payload)}});
const b=$input.first().json;return [event('REVIEW_PRESENTED',b.row.run_id,'review','Exact saved draft prepared for authenticated human review.',{row:b.row,reviewer:b.reviewer},b.row.account_id,b.row.version_token)];

const event=(type,run,stage,message,payload,account='',token='')=>({json:{event_type:type,run_id:run,execution_id:String($execution.id),account_id:account,version_token:token,recorded_at:new Date().toISOString(),stage,message,payload_json:JSON.stringify(payload)}});
const d=$input.first().json;return [event('REVIEW_SUBMITTED',d.row_before.run_id,'review','Authenticated human decision recorded for this exact version; conditional application follows.',d,d.row_before.account_id,d.row_before.version_token)];

const rows=$input.all().map(i=>i.json).filter(r=>Object.keys(r).length>0);const d=$('Validate human decision').first().json;if(rows.length!==1||rows[0].version_token!==d.row_before.version_token||Object.keys(d.patch).some(k=>rows[0][k]!==d.patch[k]))throw new Error('REVIEW_STALE: this decision was not applied because the draft changed or was already reviewed');return [{json:{...d,row_after:rows[0]}}];

parameters.content:
## Human review for a fictional portfolio
Paste storage_config from Setup complete and your n8n sign-in email into Reviewer settings. Keep n8n User Auth, Require Workflow Execute Permission, and Include User in Output enabled.

Approval is specific to the displayed current version. Returning a draft records feedback; the scheduler generates a new version for fresh review. Ready for manual sending is an internal output view. No client communication is sent.

Runtime checks to capture: approval of a current version; return, revision and new approval; rejection of an older open form. Stop after the fixed demonstration checklist is complete.
